verses.text: Again the Israelites did evil in the LORD's eyes, so the LORD gave them into the hands of the Philistines for forty years.
There was a man named Manoah from Zorah, from the tribe of Dan. His wife was unable to have children and had none.
The angel of the LORD appeared to her and said, "You have not been able to have children, but you are going to become pregnant and give birth to a son.
So be careful not to drink wine or any other strong drink, and do not eat anything unclean.
You will become pregnant and have a son. No razor may ever be used on his head, because the boy will be set apart to God as a Nazirite from birth. He will begin to save Israel from the Philistines."
Then the woman went to her husband and told him, "A man of God came to me. He looked like an angel of God, very frightening. I did not ask him where he came from, and he did not tell me his name.

But he said to me, 'You will become pregnant and have a son. So do not drink wine or other strong drink, and do not eat anything unclean, because the boy will be a Nazirite to God from birth until the day he dies.'"
Then Manoah prayed to the LORD: "Please, Lord, let the man of God you sent come to us again to teach us how to bring up the boy who is to be born."
God heard Manoah, and the angel of God came again to the woman while she was out in the field. But her husband Manoah was not with her.
She ran quickly and told her husband, "He is here! The man who came to me the other day has appeared again!"
Manoah got up and followed his wife. When he came to the man, he asked, "Are you the one who talked to my wife?" "I am," he said.
So Manoah asked him, "When your words come true, what rules should we follow for the boy's life and work?"
The angel of the LORD answered, "Your wife must do everything I told her.
She must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine, nor drink wine or any other strong drink, nor eat anything unclean. She must obey everything I have commanded her."
Manoah said to the angel of the LORD, "Please stay until we prepare a young goat for you."
The angel of the LORD replied, "Even if I stay, I will not eat your food. But if you prepare a burnt offering, offer it to the LORD." Manoah did not realise that it was the angel of the LORD.
Then Manoah asked the angel of the LORD, "What is your name, so that we may honour you when your words come true?"
He replied, "Why do you ask my name? It is too wonderful to understand."
Then Manoah took a young goat, together with a grain offering, and sacrificed it on a rock to the LORD. And while Manoah and his wife watched, the LORD did an amazing thing.
As the flame rose up from the altar toward the sky, the angel of the LORD went up in the flame. When Manoah and his wife saw this, they fell with their faces to the ground.
The angel of the LORD did not appear again to Manoah and his wife. Then Manoah realised that it was the angel of the LORD.
"We are sure to die," he said to his wife. "We have seen God!"
But his wife answered, "If the LORD meant to kill us, he would not have accepted our burnt offering and grain offering. He would not have shown us all these things or told us all this now."
The woman gave birth to a boy and named him Samson. He grew, and the LORD blessed him.
The Spirit of the LORD began to stir him while he was in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
